traditional: The day's conversations meet the chapter's; some subjects belong to the past, one belongs to the path.

modern.blend: The question that keeps arriving from different mouths; the chapter is speaking.
modern.harmonious: The introduction or idea that belongs to the future arrives through an ordinary channel.
modern.hard: The catch-up call that only rehearses the past; the pitch aimed at a closed door.
modern.business: Take the conversation that advances the direction; archive the ones that only recap.

cyclicNote: Node entries read to the axis: contact with one node is always contact with both; never render separate NN and SN cards for one event.
